card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A single digit that begins a two- or three-digit number, shown as its own piece, when the next piece continues the number. It appears in ages, ranges, percentages and scores, such as 32, 42, 75 and 25.

card.writes: It seems to suppress continuations that are not the rest of a number, though the promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a number like 32 or 75, just before the next digit arrives.
